title: Unnumbered head-curve expression in Figure 4.6
applicability: Figure 4.6: System head curve for a pumping system. The curve is labelled Hf + v²/(2g); the dashed horizontal line is labelled STATIC HEAD and H_stat. The horizontal marks are Q/4, Q/2, 3Q/4, Q, 5Q/4 and 3Q/2. Source: CPHEEO, 1993.
notes: Transcriber note: p289-1 is a service locator, not a printed equation number. This is a curve label rather than an equality; symbol meanings and units are not written out in the figure. No curve coordinates have been inferred.
